name: hero
description: A full-width hero with an optional image, richtext heading/copy and CTA buttons, offering six style variants (home background-image, solid banner, plain white, gradient banner, and two image/text split layouts) selected via a Style dropdown.

contentPattern.structure: An optional image row plus a richtext row (heading, paragraph, CTAs); image is used as a full-bleed background, a right-bleeding illustration, or a side-by-side panel depending on the variant
